# Manoj Airtel Wi-Fi Internet — Extended Fact Sheet

## Business overview

Manoj Airtel Wi-Fi Internet is an authorized Airtel dealer based in Sonipat, Haryana, India, operating since 2016. The business provides Airtel Xstream Fiber (wired) and Airtel AirFiber (wireless) broadband with speeds up to 1 Gbps for homes, offices and businesses, along with Airtel postpaid and corporate SIM connections, and Internet Leased Line (ILL) solutions.

- Business name: Manoj Airtel Wi-Fi Internet
- Established: 2016
- Sonipat office address: Shop No. 13, 2nd Floor, Subhash Chowk, Municipal Colony, Ashok Nagar, Atlas Road, Sonipat, Haryana 131001, India
- Kundli office address: Shop No. 14, Dahiya Market, near Makhan Bhog, Kundli, Sonipat, Haryana 131028, India (same business name and phone 9255820000; hours 7:00 AM to 7:30 PM)
- Phone / WhatsApp: 9255820000
- Website: https://manojairtelwifiinternet.in
- Service areas: Sonipat, Kundli, TDI Kingsbury, Gohana, Ganaur, Kharkhoda, Rai Industrial Area, Barhi, Murthal and surrounding areas in Haryana

## Services offered

1. Airtel Xstream Fiber — wired fiber-to-the-home broadband, speeds up to 1 Gbps
2. Airtel AirFiber — wireless broadband, no cable digging required, ideal where fiber cabling isn't feasible
3. Airtel Postpaid SIM & MNP — individual and family postpaid mobile plans, number porting support
4. Airtel Corporate Postpaid SIMs — business mobile plans with GST input credit, bulk porting, dedicated relationship manager
5. Internet Leased Line (ILL) — dedicated 1:1 bandwidth for offices, factories, warehouses and IT setups
6. PG & Hostel Wi-Fi Connection — Wi-Fi setup for PG accommodations and hostels, shared or private room plans
7. Society & Apartment Bulk Wi-Fi Connection — bulk Wi-Fi/broadband setup for housing societies and apartment complexes (including TDI Kingsbury), coordinated installation across multiple flats/towers

## Airtel Xstream Fiber plans (wired broadband)

- Basic: 40 Mbps, ₹499/month — Unlimited data, free all-India landline calling, free Wi-Fi router
- Entertainment: 30 Mbps, ₹599/month — 350+ TV channels, 22+ OTT apps (excl. Netflix, Prime Video, Apple TV), free landline calling
- Popular: 100 Mbps, ₹799/month — Unlimited fast data, free landline calling, free Wi-Fi router
- Entertainment Plus: 100 Mbps, ₹899/month — 350+ TV channels, 22+ OTT apps, free landline calling
- Value Plan (Most Popular): 100 Mbps, ₹999/month — Unlimited high-speed data, free landline calling, bundled OTT (Netflix, Amazon Prime Video and more)
- Ultimate TV + OTT: 100 Mbps, ₹1,199/month — 350+ TV channels, free landline calling
- Ultra Speed: 300 Mbps, ₹1,599/month — 350+ TV channels, free landline calling
- Ultra Speed 1 Gbps: 1 Gbps, ₹3,999/month — 350+ TV channels, free landline calling

## Airtel AirFiber plans (wireless broadband)

- Basic: 40 Mbps, ₹499/month — up to 1 TB/month high-speed data (post-limit speed as per Airtel terms), free Wi-Fi router, wireless setup (no digging required)
- Entertainment: 30 Mbps, ₹599/month — 350+ TV channels, 22+ OTT apps, wireless setup
- Popular: 100 Mbps, ₹799/month — up to 1 TB/month high-speed data (post-limit speed as per Airtel terms), free Wi-Fi router, wireless setup
- Entertainment Plus: 100 Mbps, ₹899/month — 350+ TV channels, 22+ OTT apps, wireless setup
- Value Plan (Most Popular): 100 Mbps, ₹999/month — up to 1 TB/month high-speed data (post-limit speed as per Airtel terms), wireless setup, bundled OTT
- Ultimate TV + OTT: 100 Mbps, ₹1,199/month — 350+ TV channels, wireless setup

Prices are indicative and plus 18% GST; installation and the Wi-Fi router are free on every plan; customers are advised to confirm current offers via phone or WhatsApp before booking.

## Airtel Corporate Postpaid SIM plans (business mobile)

- ₹349/month: 30GB data, unlimited voice, Airtel Call Manager, premium app bundle
- ₹399/month: 40GB data, unlimited voice, Tracemate, Airtel Call Manager, premium app bundle
- ₹449/month: 60GB data, unlimited voice, Tracemate, Airtel Call Manager, premium app bundle
- ₹549/month: 100GB data, unlimited voice, Tracemate, Airtel Call Manager, premium app bundle
- ₹1,649/month: 500GB data, unlimited voice, Tracemate, Airtel Call Manager, premium app bundle

Corporate benefits: GST input credit for registered businesses, retain existing company numbers on bulk porting, dedicated relationship manager, one consolidated bill, fraud & phishing-link protection on select plans.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: How can I get a new Airtel Xstream Fiber connection?
A: Call or WhatsApp 9255820000. Quick installation is available in Sonipat, Kundli, Rai, Murthal, Kharkhoda, Ganaur, Gohana and Barhi.

Q: What is Airtel AirFiber?
A: Airtel AirFiber is a wireless high-speed broadband service that delivers fast internet without laying fiber cables — ideal where digging isn't possible.

Q: Do you provide same-day installation?
A: About 70% of installations are completed the same day. For farther locations the installation is completed by the next day. Subject to feasibility at the customer's address.

Q: Do I need to visit the store?
A: No. On a call or online booking, service is given at the customer's location (door-to-door), including online booking for Panipat, Rohtak, Karnal, Kurukshetra and Hisar. For these five cities the actual installation is carried out by Airtel's own technicians.

Q: Is installation free? Is the router free?
A: Yes. Installation and the Wi-Fi router are free on every Airtel plan.

Q: How does the ₹1,500 advance work?
A: The ₹1,500 advance is adjusted in your first three bills (about 2 months 16 days of free internet on the ₹499 plan with 18% GST, about 1 month 17 days on the ₹799 plan), and from the 3rd bill you get ₹100 off every bill for the next 10 months. Subject to Airtel's current offer and billing terms.

Q: What are the support hours?
A: Sonipat office 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM daily; Kundli office 7:00 AM to 7:30 PM. Call or WhatsApp 9255820000.

Q: Which areas do you serve?
A: Sonipat, Kundli, Rai, Murthal, Kharkhoda, Ganaur, Gohana, Barhi and surrounding areas. Online booking also available for Panipat, Rohtak, Karnal, Kurukshetra and Hisar.

Q: Can I port my existing number to Airtel Postpaid?
A: Yes — Mobile Number Portability (MNP) is supported; customers can bring their current number to an Airtel postpaid plan.
